mainEntity.name: What is a crypto press release service and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto press release service writes the announcement, identifies the right reporters, pitches them directly and gets confirmed placements in tier-1 crypto and mainstream outlets. It is for Web3, DePIN, AI and cybersecurity founders who have a real news moment, such as a raise, mainnet, listing or partnership, and need the story covered rather than just distributed. The work at this level is different from a wire-only service because the outcome is a placed article, not a PDF on a syndication network.

mainEntity.name: How much does a crypto press release service cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single press release written, pitched and placed runs as part of a retainer at $5K–$12K/month, which covers ongoing media relations and content alongside the release work. A standalone launch sprint, covering the release, embargo management and initial placement push, runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks. Full agencies charge $15K–$45K/month for the same scope. Pricing depends on the number of target outlets, the APAC localisation requirement and the embargo complexity.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you place a crypto press release in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto where the news warrants it: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream where the angle crosses over: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga, AI Magazine. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Placement is never guaranteed because editors decide, but the pitch approach, built around a real news hook to a specific beat reporter, is what makes the difference between coverage and the delete key.

mainEntity.name: How long does the process take from brief to placement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Draft turnaround is two to three business days from a complete brief. Embargo windows for tier-1 placements run seven to fourteen days, giving reporters time to write original coverage rather than a wire recap. Same-day placements are possible for breaking news on an existing retainer. For a launch, the ideal lead time is four to six weeks before the public announcement date, so the narrative, the reporter list and the embargo logistics are already in place.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with the crypto press release service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form with your announcement, target outlets and timeline. You will get a reply within 24 hours with a read on whether the news hook is strong enough, which reporters are the right fit and what the process looks like. Or book a 30-minute call to map it out live. No deck, no agency intake form.
